description: This file declares classes for optional SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) expanders used in TensorFlow's MLIR-based tensor distribution. It defines the interface for classes that perform expansion, and compute tensor layouts for operations related to optional values within the DTensor framework.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)
StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& output_layouts)

classes.name: OptionalGetValueSPMDExpander
classes.description: Implements expansion and layout computation for operations retrieving optional values in the MLIR/DTensor framework.

classes.name: OptionalHasValueSPMDExpander
classes.description: Implements expansion and layout computation for operations checking for the presence of a value in the MLIR/DTensor framework.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Performs operation expansion for the specific optional value operation.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the output layout based on input layouts during the forward pass.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the input layouts based on output layouts during the backward pass.
